[FMLA 10] VoltageGain — Voltage Gain

Decibel voltage gain between input and output.

Calculator scroll name: VoltageGain. Decibel voltage gain between input and output.

formula
G=20log10​(Vin​Vout​​)

Voltage gain in decibels is a compressed way to write a ratio. A ratio of 10 is 20 dB; a ratio of 100 is 40 dB. If Vout is smaller than Vin, G is negative (a loss).

keys
FMLA→1→0

Primary inputs: E′ (output), E (input).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 0 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

Output E′ = 30 V, input E = 12 V
30 EXE 12 EXE → G = 7.9588 dB
note

Vin and Vout in the same voltage unit (E′/E > 0). G is in dB. A ratio below 1 gives negative gain (a loss).
